سَمَّاعٌ One who hearkens, or listens, much to what is said, and utters it. (TA.) [Its primary signification is simply One who hears, hearkens, or listens, much, or habitually: and it signifies also quick of hearing.] See also سَامِعٌ. ―
-b2- A spy, who searches for information, and brings it. (TA.) ―
-b3- (assumed tropical:) Obedient. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
